content.text: In Nigeria, Zimbabwe, or any country where Stripe, PayPal, and Gumroad are blocked, [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/selling-music-online-accepting-bitcoin-explained-digital-creators-5|COREMERCH guide to selling]]-music-online-accepting-bitcoin-every-detail-you-3|Selling Music]] ebooks and digital products can be a nightmare. Without a trusted payment gateway, creators are forced to rely on unreliable intermediaries, paying 10% commission to Gumroad, or worse, losing sales due to platform restrictions. But there's a better way: [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/building-crypto-store-cloudflare-pages-step-step-deployment-5|building]] a sovereign digital commerce stack that puts you, the creator, in control. By leveraging Cloudflare Pages, Cloudflare Workers, and NOWPayments, you can accept bitcoin and other cryptocurrencies for ebook sales, retaining 99.5% of your revenue. In this guide, we'll show you how to deploy this infrastructure in just a few hours, and scale your sales without relying on centralized platforms.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/understanding-automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-plain-language-5. content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Bitcoin ebook

Platforms like Gumroad and Payhip may have worked in the past, but they come with hefty fees and restrictive terms. By contrast, a sovereign digital commerce stack is built on free and open-source tools, allowing you to retain 99.5% of your revenue. With this infrastructure, you're not relying on a third-party platform to process payments or deliver your ebooks – you're in control, every step of the way. This means you can sell your ebooks without paying 10% commission to Gumroad, and you can scale your sales without worrying about platform restrictions.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you can deploy your sovereign digital commerce stack, you'll need a few key tools. First, you'll need a hosting platform like Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages. Next, you'll need a backend logic tool like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Finally, you'll need a payment processor like NOWPayments, which supports 300+ cryptocurrencies and charges just 0.5% fee. By leveraging these tools, you can create a seamless payment and delivery pipeline for your ebook sales.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To set up your payment and delivery pipeline, you'll need to integrate your payment processor with your hosting platform and backend logic tool. This involves creating a Cloudflare Worker or Google Apps Script that listens for payment notifications from NOWPayments and delivers your ebook to the customer. With this setup, you can automate your payment and delivery process, ensuring a seamless experience for your customers.
By leveraging a sovereign digital commerce stack, you can retain 99.5% of your revenue and scale your sales without relying on centralized platforms.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once you've set up your payment and delivery pipeline, it's time to go live. This involves deploying your hosting platform and backend logic tool to a production environment, and configuring your payment processor to accept payments. By following our step-by-step guide, you can deploy your sovereign digital commerce stack in just a few hours and start processing transactions in no time.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Once your infrastructure is up and running, you can start scaling your sales to new heights. With a sovereign digital commerce stack, you can add more products, increase your pricing, and reach new customers without worrying about platform restrictions. By leveraging the Complete Builder Kit ($197), you can get everything you need to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack, including 6 blueprints and 7 templates, all for just $197.

The most common question we get is: 'How do I sell ebooks without relying on Stripe or PayPal?' The answer is simple: build a sovereign digital commerce stack using Cloudflare Pages, Cloudflare Workers, and NOWPayments. With this infrastructure, you can retain 99.5% of your revenue and scale your sales without worrying about platform restrictions. By following our step-by-step guide, you can deploy your sovereign digital commerce stack in just a few hours and start selling ebooks without relying on centralized platforms.
With NOWPayments, you can accept 300+ cryptocurrencies and charge just 0.5% fee.

You can also visit our shop at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to learn more about our other products and services.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy your sovereign digital commerce stack, follow these steps: 1. Set up your hosting platform, such as Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages; 2. Create a backend logic tool, such as a Cloudflare Worker or Google Apps Script; 3. Integrate your payment processor, NOWPayments, with your hosting platform and backend logic tool; 4. Deploy your hosting platform and backend logic tool to a production environment; 5. Configure your payment processor to accept payments; 6. Test your infrastructure to ensure seamless payment and delivery; 7. Go live and start processing transactions.
